partTypes.name: Outpost
partTypes.description: A new outpost you found. Starts with nothing — connect routes to give it builders, cargo, or an escort fleet.

partTypes.name: Allied outpost
partTypes.description: Already held by an ally. You can't add or remove these, only connect routes to them.

partTypes.name: Hostile outpost
partTypes.description: Hostile territory. You can't remove it — you can only route an escort fleet there and hold it.

partTypes.name: Builder route
partTypes.description: Moves 1 unit of builders per tick from source to target, while the source has any to send.

partTypes.name: Builder express route
partTypes.description: A higher-throughput builder route: moves 3 units of builders per tick.

partTypes.name: Cargo route
partTypes.description: Moves 1 unit of cargo per tick from source to target, while the source has any to send.

partTypes.name: Cargo express route
partTypes.description: A higher-throughput cargo route: moves 3 units of cargo per tick.

partTypes.name: Fleet route
partTypes.description: Moves 1 escort fleet hull per tick from source to target, while the source has any to send.
